verdict.rationale: dLocal sends signed notifications to a merchant URL on every payment status change, so an agent can monitor failed payments through webhooks and the API. Saved-card `card_id` charges and wallet enrollment IDs let an agent re-attempt charges. However, there is no documented retry logic, smart-retry scheduling, or dunning or customer-outreach capability, so the agent would have to build retries and dunning itself. Missing for 10: documented automatic or configurable payment retries, dunning workflows or customer outreach, failed-payment-specific reporting or querying, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
